entries.title: Psalms 22:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician upon Aijeleth Shahar, A Psalm of David.>> My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? [why art thou so] far from helping me, [and from] the words of my roaring? {Aijeleth...: or, the hind of the morning} {helping...: Heb. my salvation}

words.text: ? {Aijeleth...: or, the hind of the morning} {helping...: Heb. my salvation}

entries.title: Psalms 22:2
segments: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent. {am...: Heb. there is no silence to me}

words.text: not; and in the night season
. {am...: Heb. there is no silence to me}

entries.title: Psalms 22:3
segments: But thou [art] holy, [O thou] that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 22:4
segments: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

entries.title: Psalms 22:5
segments: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

words.text: in thee, and were not confounded

entries.title: Psalms 22:6
segments: But I [am] a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.

entries.title: Psalms 22:7
segments: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, [saying], {shoot...: Heb. open}

entries.title: Psalms 22:8
segments: He trusted on the LORD [that] he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him. {He trusted...: Heb. He rolled himself on} {seeing...: or, if he delight in}

words.text: in him. {He trusted...: Heb. He rolled himself on} {seeing...: or, if he delight in}

entries.title: Psalms 22:9
segments: But thou [art] he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope [when I was] upon my mother's breasts. {didst...: or, kept me in safety}

entries.title: Psalms 22:10
segments: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou [art] my God from my mother's belly.

entries.title: Psalms 22:11
segments: ¶Be not far from me; for trouble [is] near; for [there is] none to help. {none...: Heb. not a helper}

entries.title: Psalms 22:12
segments: Many bulls have compassed me: strong [bulls] of Bashan have beset me round.

entries.title: Psalms 22:13
segments: They gaped upon me [with] their mouths, [as] a ravening and a roaring lion. {gaped...: Heb. opened their mouths against me}

words.text: . {gaped...: Heb. opened their mouths against me}

entries.title: Psalms 22:14
segments: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels. {out of...: or, sundered}

entries.title: Psalms 22:15
segments: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

entries.title: Psalms 22:16
segments: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.

entries.title: Psalms 22:17
segments: I may tell all my bones: they look [and] stare upon me.

entries.title: Psalms 22:18
segments: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

entries.title: Psalms 22:19
segments: But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.

entries.title: Psalms 22:20
segments: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog. {my darling: Heb. my only one} {power: Heb. hand}

words.text: . {my darling: Heb. my only one} {power: Heb. hand}

entries.title: Psalms 22:21
segments: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.

entries.title: Psalms 22:22
segments: ¶I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.

entries.title: Psalms 22:23
segments: Ye that fear the LORD, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 22:24
segments: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.

words.text: from him; but when he cried

entries.title: Psalms 22:25
segments: My praise [shall be] of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

words.text: [shall be] of thee in the great

entries.title: Psalms 22:26
segments: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 22:27
segments: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

entries.title: Psalms 22:28
segments: For the kingdom [is] the LORD'S: and he [is] the governor among the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 22:29
segments: All [they that be] fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.

words.text: him: and none can keep alive

entries.title: Psalms 22:30
segments: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

entries.title: Psalms 22:31
segments: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done [this].
